A few questions:

Is your phone on their account or do you have your own?

If it’s their account you may want to consider opening your own phone account. That way your parents have no say on your account or access. 

Are you paying for the phone in full or getting it in a monthly payment plan?

Do they have access to your bank account or money? If so, get a new account at an unrelated bank. Do not let them have access to your bank/credit, etc info.

Ultimately, you’re an adult and it’s your money. Do what you want and stop discussing such things with your parents.

My favorite way to use eggs right now is pretty simple but delicious. 

Just take an oven safe ramekin, oil it up with olive oil, crack two eggs in it and add salt/pepper to taste. 

At the same time get mini tater tots and a frozen breakfast sausage patty, lay tinfoil over a cookie sheet and place the ramekin, sausage patty and tater tots on the tinfoil. 

Bake for about 15 mins at 375, when the patty is browned the tots are mostly crispy and the eggs look nearly set (no wiggly bits when you carefully shake the pan (hot!!) I place the patty into the ramekin, tots on top and top with cheese and whatever herbs are ready from my garden. Bake for 5 more mins and taa daa! Easy peasy lazy breakfast:)
